caption:
In this Shorts video, Backpacker Indian is sharing Bangalore Street Food under 50 rupees. While roaming in the morning, Arpit found out there are good hygienic breakfast places in the city who serves food under 50 rupees. From Idli, Vada to Filter Coffee, this Street side spot has everything. Watch till the end of the shorts to know honest review about this budget friendly breakfast.

Location: By2Coffee, Bengaluru, Karnataka
